name: application-collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: A single expand/collapse content section with a button trigger and rotating chevron, driven by real aria-expanded state.
useWhen: Hiding a single block of secondary content — comments, details, logs — behind a toggle to reduce initial visual weight.
Progressive disclosure for one section, where showing/hiding is independent of any sibling sections.
You need the disclosure pattern without the multi-item accordion semantics (single-open/multi-open groups).
avoidWhen: You have several related sections that should share open/close behavior as a group — use `accordions` instead.
The content is short enough to just show — collapsing it adds an interaction cost without a real space payoff.
The trigger needs to reveal a small floating panel anchored to it rather than push content inline — use `popover` instead.
responsiveBehavior: Trigger and panel are both full-width block elements, so the component reflows naturally at any container width.
accessibility: The trigger is a real <button> with aria-expanded reflecting open state.
aria-controls on the trigger references the panel's id so assistive tech can associate them.
The chevron icon is aria-hidden since its rotation is a redundant visual cue, not the source of truth.

variants.title: Collapsible
variants.description: Expand/collapse section showing a comment thread, open by default.
accessibility: aria-expanded toggles between true/false as real state, not just a visual chevron flip.

variants.title: Collapsible (Dark)
